ai_requirements.text: Redact customer personal data, credentials, and hostnames prior to model invocation with auditable logging.
Ensure model inference and data persistence remain strictly within EU boundaries with zero cross-border retention.
Maintain an auditable log of model requests and cited sources for 24 months.
Enforce legal and technical guarantees preventing third-party model providers from training on customer support data.

ai_requirements.validation_reason: Latency threshold depends on customer confirmation of acceptable agent wait time.
ai_requirements.text: Target response generation latency under 4 seconds for agent sidebar draft streaming.

use_cases.name: Grounded Reply Drafting with Source Attribution
use_cases.description: Generates contextual support response drafts grounded in product docs, runbooks, and past tickets with cited source links.
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Hybrid vector and keyword search across enterprise vector indexes containing Confluence, GitHub, SharePoint, and historical tickets.
use_cases.orchestration: Step-based workflow with query optimization, metadata filtering, document retrieval, and response synthesis.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: System prompts with strict schema validation enforcing structured output arrays for citations and confidence tags.
use_cases.evaluation: Offline evaluation using groundedness and response correctness metrics on historical reference tickets.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Pre-inference PII scrubbing in ARC_10 and citation validation to prevent hallucinated advice.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Tracking agent edit distance, response acceptance rates, and latency metrics in ARC_11.
use_cases.human_review: Mandatory review and approval by support agents in ARC_01 prior to sending any response.
use_cases.data_privacy: EU regional model inference with zero vendor data logging and zero model training on customer data.

use_cases.name: Ticket Classification and SLA Priority Suggestion
use_cases.description: Classifies incoming tickets by product line and issue type while suggesting priority based on SLA rules.
use_cases.pattern: Structured Output Classification with Deterministic SLA Guardrails
use_cases.retrieval_notes: No retrieval required; evaluates ticket payload and metadata directly.
use_cases.orchestration: Pipeline extracting classification tags and passing candidates to deterministic SLA mapping logic.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: JSON schema enforcing enum values for category, issue type, and recommended priority level.
use_cases.evaluation: Precision and recall scoring evaluated against historical manual ticket routing records.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: PII filtering prior to classification with fallback to manual routing when confidence is low.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Real-time monitoring of ticket re-routing rates and agent override frequencies.
use_cases.human_review: Triage agents review and confirm predicted category and queue before ticket reassignment.
use_cases.data_privacy: Inference processed entirely within EU regional cloud boundaries.

use_cases.name: Similar Past Ticket Retrieval
use_cases.description: Retrieves and displays top relevant historical tickets alongside their resolutions, filtering out obsolete advice.
use_cases.pattern: Semantic Similarity Search with Metadata Decay Filtering
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Vector search over ARC_08 filtered by product area and ticket resolution date cutoff.
use_cases.orchestration: Embedding creation and vector lookup with dynamic score boosting for recent resolutions.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: Direct JSON structure returning ticket ID, subject summary, and resolution snippet.
use_cases.evaluation: Precision at K metrics against expert-curated similar ticket benchmark sets.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Automatic stripping of internal hostnames and customer credentials from historical snippets.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Logging agent click-through and usage rates on suggested past tickets.
use_cases.human_review: Agents assess applicability of past resolutions before incorporating them into replies.
use_cases.data_privacy: Historical ticket vectors stored securely in enterprise EU vector database.

deterministic_areas.text: Queue routing execution and contractual SLA priority overrides are managed via rule-based business logic.
PII, credential, and internal hostname stripping is performed using deterministic pattern matching in ARC_10.
Bi-weekly ingestion scheduling and metadata timestamp filtering for deprecated ticket exclusion are handled deterministically.

mandatory_human_decisions.text: Final review, editing, and transmission of every outbound support reply to customers.
Manual confirmation of queue re-routing or SLA priority changes for edge-case tickets.

architecture_pattern: Event-driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agent-assist architecture with modular multi-source ingestion and PII security proxy.

provider_options.rationale: Offers native EU regional processing in europe-west3 with guaranteed zero model training on customer data and strong enterprise integration support.
Bedrock EU Frankfurt endpoints provide isolated managed inference, zero data logging, and strict data residency compliance.
Azure OpenAI EU Sweden and France regions offer enterprise data privacy guarantees and managed content safety guardrails.

framework_recommendations.name: LangChain / LangGraph (TypeScript)
framework_recommendations.purpose: Orchestrating stateful RAG workflows, structured JSON extraction, and citation mapping.
framework_recommendations.rationale: Fits the 9-person platform team without requiring dedicated ML engineering, aligning cleanly with Node/React web components for Zendesk.

framework_recommendations.name: LlamaIndex
framework_recommendations.purpose: Multi-source repository ingestion, document chunking, and metadata-based deprecation filtering.
framework_recommendations.rationale: Provides built-in indexing pipelines and metadata filtering tailored for Confluence, SharePoint, and GitHub documentation.
